detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Assemble the Ultimate Team

Build a team through endless combinations of Batomon, trainers, encounters, trinkets and items. Take advantage of synergies and combos of Batomon that break the game and become overpowered. Battle and defeat other players on your road to become a champion.

Battle Other Players

Every battle is a new discovery. Dive into asynchronous multiplayer to face a near-infinite variety of player-made teams. Play at your own relaxed paced with no timers to rush your decisions. Build the ultimate team to let the world try to break it.

Level up your Batomon

Every Batomon holds infinite potential. Through a deep system of unique abilities, trinkets, and items, you can push your team beyond their limits. Theorycraft your way to victory, as any Batomon can become a powerhouse capable of shattering the meta.

Choose Your Trainer

Master a diverse lineup of trainers, each bringing a game-changing abilities to the field. From eccentric bug-catchers and dragon-whisperers to chefs who can cook new types onto of your Batomon, every trainer offers a fresh path to becoming a champion.
